text:
jana: Quick announcement  we're opening a constrained preview for B500-Lite dedicated micro-pools in eu-south (Milan) and af-south (Accra). Aiming at customers who need regional inference with modest memory but high QPS. Reservations open 2026-05-05 03:00 UTC via Console + API. :wave:
devin: Are these new hardware nodes or reprofiled B500s? Any perf knobs?
jana: B500-Lite is a tuned profile (power & mem tradeoffs). Best for int8/int4 work; expect p50 ~55ms for 6k context on 3-unit reservation. We'll publish a perf note.
amar: SLA and burst policy?
jana: SLA: 99.8% reserved availability during preview. Burst policy: regional burst up to 10% for 4m windows, twice/day; bursts are metered and limited early in preview.
ops-bot: Fleet allocations: eu-south = 36 units (9 clusters), af-south = 20 units (5 clusters). Preview per-org cap: 6 units.
deploy-bot: Rollout: canary -> incremental -> GA. Canary starts 2026-05-05 03:00 UTC. Monitoring hooks enabled.
devin: Migration path for existing B500 reserved customers?
jana: We'll offer conversion credits and a 30d overlap window. Submit migration interest form: https://intra.redwood.io/dedicated/migrate-b500 (internal).
billing: Preview reservations use SKU b500-lite.preview and are not billed until conversion or GA opt-in. Conversion offers include prorated credit for active commitments. For custom pricing email billing@redwood.com.
legal: Heads-up  any export or regional compliance notes for Accra deployment?
amar: Accra cluster uses customer-data-in-region controls and standard KMS integration; legal to confirm any country-specific export filters.
jana: API example (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/dedicated/reservations \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"region":"af-south","gpu_type":"b500-lite","units":2,"term_months":3}'
```
ops-bot: Quota increases: use Console > Support > Dedicated quotas. Typical preview turnaround 24-72h.
jana: I'll run a 30m walkthrough tomorrow 14:00 CEST in #dedicated to demo reservation flow and migration tips. Ping me for slots. :calendar:
